procurement.note: seeded by CAD 2026-09-12 during schema validation; EE links OPN when the SB4 camera track registers one

physical.dims_note: board bbox; CAD uses manufacturer STEP (RP-008154-DS-1) for the exact B-rep - lens barrel solids extend below the board bbox face, see orientation

mount.pattern: nose lens-forward pair (CAD placement pins pi_camera_3#left/right)

orientation.optical_axis: +X after mount rotation (lens-forward out the nose aperture)
orientation.die_frame: native manufacturer STEP models the board flat with the LENS POINTING -Z (lens-barrel solids sit at native z < -2mm, below the board face)
orientation.mount_rotation_note: -90deg about Y maps the native -Z lens axis to +X lens-forward. (+90 about Y stands the board up but points the lens BACKWARD -X; shipped that way once in CAD d69c9de and was user-reported wrong 2026-09-04.)
orientation.fov_note: 66.3h x 41.6v deg FOV pyramid; chassis must keep frame material out of it (CAD cam_down hard gate)

ee.footprint_note: not a board-mounted part - connects via CSI flex to the SB4 camera host (CM4 2x CSI); no footprint needed

interface.note: pair mounts lens-forward at the nose, feeds the CM4 dual CSI

camera.provenance: no sim consumer yet (headless sim carries no camera model, same gap class as IMU); block reserved
